caption: A patch of a wet window is wiped dry with a cloth, and the view through the patch becomes sharp.

sa.check: A patch is wiped dry with a cloth.
The view through the patch becomes sharp.
The wipe comes first and the sharp view follows.

pc.expect: The clear patch matches the wiped area and the view outside it stays blurred by the water.
pc.fail: The whole pane clears from one wipe; or the wiped patch stays blurred; or a clear patch appears where nothing was wiped.

pc.expect: The outside scene does not change.
pc.fail: The scene changes; or a different view appears in the patch; or the glass warps.

pc.expect: The water is a film the cloth removes.
pc.fail: It is a solid coating; or it reforms instantly; or the cloth passes through the glass.

pc.expect: The cloth moves only with the hand.
pc.fail: It wipes by itself; or floats; or jumps.
The window duplicates; or the cloth vanishes; or the cloth passes through the pane.

pc.expect: The frame and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The frame changes; or the room rearranges; or the cloth changes colour.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
